headline: Cuerpo to travel to Ceuta to discuss economic support with businesses and social agents after the migration crisis
summary: Spain's First Vice President and Economy Minister Carlos Cuerpo will travel to Ceuta to discuss economic support with businesses and social agents following the migration crisis.
why: Ceuta is a Spanish exclave in North Africa whose local economy depends heavily on trade and cross-border activity, so federal support measures affect regional business conditions.

original_headline: Cuerpo viajará a Ceuta para abordar con empresas y agentes sociales el apoyo económico tras la crisis migratoria
